change.title: Dedup tickets on save
change.description:
Keeps the **first** write per id.

Closes #12.

overview.summary: Dedups tickets before the bulk insert and backfills the new bucket column.
overview.concerns: Ordering of the dedup, and whether the backfill runs on read or on write.

files.summary: do_save/2 drops repeated ids before the bulk insert.
files.diff:
@@ -145,9 +145,11 @@ defmodule Acme.Tickets do
   def do_save(items) do
     items
-    |> Enum.uniq_by(& &1.id)
-    |> Enum.reverse()
+    |> Enum.reverse()
+    |> Enum.uniq_by(& &1.id)
+    |> Enum.reverse()
     |> Repo.insert_all()
   end
 
   defp normalise(item), do: item

files.summary: Adds the bucket column and backfills it in batches.
files.diff:
@@ -1,6 +1,8 @@
 defmodule Acme.Repo.Migrations.AddBucket do
   use Ecto.Migration
 
   def change do
-    alter table(:tickets), do: add(:bucket, :string)
+    alter table(:tickets), do: add(:bucket, :string, default: "main")
+    execute("UPDATE tickets SET bucket = COALESCE(bucket, 'main')", "")
   end
 end

proposals.title: reversing twice is a no-op with a cost
proposals.body:
The second `Enum.reverse/1` undoes the first, so `uniq_by` still keeps the last write.

```suggestion
    |> Enum.uniq_by(& &1.id)
```

proposals.title: COALESCE hides a real NULL
proposals.body: Agreed with the backfill, but the default should stay off until it ran.

comments.author: reviewer-bot
comments.body: A default on the column masks rows the backfill missed.
